Hero.title: Ticketing System
Hero.subtitle: LAIT (Leading Access to Integrated Ticketing) is an integrated ticket purchasing mechanism based on reward points, offering tourism benefits that are valid throughout Indonesia.

Features.title: LAIT Features
Features.subtitle: Discover how the LAIT Ticketing System delivers convenience and ease for its users
Features.benefit1: Unified interface across all ticketing systems
Features.benefit4: Reward points remain valid as long as the user uses the application
Features.travelPassDesc: Provides transport travel pass tickets available on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
Features.rewardPointsDesc: Earn reward points with every transport ticket purchase and each ticket scan.
Features.tourismDesc: Offers various tourist attraction tickets across Indonesia, where reward points can be used as ticket discounts.
Features.paymentDesc: Supports various payment methods for ticket purchases, including QRIS, Virtual Account, Debit, and Credit Card.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: Last updated: February 20, 2026
Privacy.intro: LAIT ("we", "our", or "the Platform") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data.
Privacy.collectDesc: We collect account information (name, email), ticketing data, and optional location data for transit features.
Privacy.useDesc: To facilitate ticket purchases, manage reward points, provide transit routing, and ensure fair competition in challenges.
Privacy.notCollectDesc: We do not store complete payment card details, private messages, or unshared fitness activity routes.
Privacy.thirdPartyDesc: We integrate with payment gateways and transport operators governing their respective data policies.
Privacy.storageDesc: Data is retained securely and only as long as necessary to provide our services or comply with legal obligations.
Privacy.rightsDesc: You have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data at any time.
Privacy.contactDesc: For privacy-related questions, reach out to privacy@lait.co.id.
